manual.title: Manual entries
manual.intro: Some indicators have no data-collection form behind them. They are recorded here — as records, not as typed totals, because each indicator counts rows and the donor return needs to know what was counted.
manual.loadFailed: Could not load these records. Check your connection and try again.
manual.countThisFar: {count, plural, =0 {none recorded} one {# recorded} other {# recorded}}

F0.1.title: Promotional actions
F0.1.hint: One record per action. The indicator counts these, so a campaign run twice is two records.

G0.3.title: Case studies
G0.3.hint: One record per documented case study. The summary and the change evidenced both go into the donor return.

manual.elsewhereIntro: These are not on this screen on purpose. Three of them count distinct people, so a typed total could double-count the same person and could never be corrected afterwards — the identities would not have been captured.

elsewhere.B1.2: Farmers reaching office services — counts distinct people, so each visit is logged against a national ID in the coordination office module.
elsewhere.D0.1: Producers guided on food safety and licensing — counts distinct people, so each session is logged against a national ID in the guidance log.
elsewhere.C1.3: Advisory mentorship sessions — each session belongs to a producer's initiative, so it is recorded against that initiative rather than counted here.
elsewhere.D0.2: Training sessions on food processing — counted from sessions marked as delivered, so it moves when you record delivery.
